decisions.reason: The GA4 plugin builds directly on the firm’s analytics and plugin expertise, and as GA4 is the current standard, the firm can assimilate and improve it.
Universal Analytics has been superseded by GA4, and the firm’s analytics knowledge allows it to recognize that the plugin’s underlying technology is obsolete, so it is likely to be dropped.
The retail interface plugin leverages the firm’s core interface and plugin development capabilities and partner network, so it fits existing knowledge and can be learned from.
The relaunch SEO service draws on existing marketing and SEO know-how and complements the firm’s shop services, so the firm can interpret results and improve it.
